title: 'Poison seller' Kenneth Law apologises in court to the families of his victims
summary: The Canadian man, who pleaded guilty to 14 counts of aiding and abetting suicide earlier this year, said he was remorseful for his actions.

title: Two American Airlines planes clip wings before takeoff at Reagan airport in 'tense' moment
summary: No injuries were reported, and the FAA plans to investigate the incident, which occurred during taxiing.

title: Hundreds of thousands still without power a day after US slammed with Thanksgiving storms
summary: Pennsylvania and neighbouring states remained badly affected on Friday after both coasts were lashed with wind and rain.
